newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Three killed in Pakistan by-election shootout.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in Pakistan by-election shootout.

text.p: Three people were killed and six injured on Thursday in a shootout between rival political parties during a by-election in Pakistan's North West Frontier province, police said.

The shooting occurred in the provincial capital Peshawar between members of the Pakistan People's Party (PPP) of former prime minister Benazir Bhutto and the Awami National Party (ANP), allied with Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif.
Police said an argument over alleged bogus voting apparantly caused the shooting.

Three people -- a son of an ANP candidate for the National Assembly (lower house), another ANP supporter and a police official -- were killed while a PPP candidate and former provincial minister Qamar Abbas, and two policemen were among those injured, the police said.
The by-election was the first held after the February 3 general elections, which Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League party won by a landslide.
Voting was not held in Peshawar on February 3 due to the death of a previous PPP candidate by heart attack.
